workflowBrief.title: Review similar photos before removing them from your Mac
workflowBrief.primaryIntent: Help a Mac owner decide which visually similar photos to retain, rather than treating a detected group as disposable duplicates.
workflowBrief.description: Cleaner One Pro documents both duplicate files and similar-photo cleanup. Use its official illustration to explain a keep/review decision; distinguish that task from investigating why Mac storage keeps growing. No hands-on matching or deletion claims.
outline: Lead with keep/review/stop decision; official Similar Photos UI immediately below lead only after rights cleared
Duplicate files and similar-looking photos are different review tasks; no unverified algorithm claims
Inspect each candidate's contents and provenance; stop when original/edit/library relationships are unclear
Separate selected file sizes from available space and do not invent storage recovery
If the problem is repeated growth instead, use a current-source Breathing Room Space example with explicit labels and disclose affiliation
Choose documented photo cleanup or preview investigation based on the actual job

comparisonBrief.title: Breathing Room vs Cleaner One Pro for Mac
comparisonBrief.primaryIntent: Choose documented category/photo/startup cleaning versus a preview for storage/activity investigation.
comparisonBrief.length: Concise sourced decision matrix, not a second expanded workflow article.
comparisonBrief.lead: Cleaner One Pro documents duplicate/similar-photo tools, app management and startup-item control. Breathing Room, which we build, is a free macOS preview with source-level investigation and approval workflows; it is not a verified substitute for every Cleaner One Pro tool.
comparisonBrief.noDoorwayRule: No additional Trend Cleaner Pro or generic alternatives page.

cleanerOneProAdvantages: Documented duplicate/similar-photo categories and startup/app management fit users seeking those specific workflows (duplicates/startup/app-manager).
Vendor minimum macOS 10.15 reaches earlier OS versions than BR's macOS 13 requirement; this is not a tested compatibility guarantee (compatibility/br-install).
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source-level activity/free-space history and developer-tool discovery suit investigating repeated growth; no unsupported absence claim about competitor (br-growth/br-dev).
Free local core and optional hosted AI pricing are explicit; no currency-adjusted cheaper claim (br-price).
tradeoffs: BR preview is not Developer ID signed/notarized and requires Python 3.10+ for inventory/legacy scripts; physical Intel and distributed parity unverified.
BR hosted AI sends relevant data and requires authentication/network; no offline-AI promise.
Cleaner One Pro current version, exact cleanup controls, developer adapters and local/hosted boundaries are not verified.
Competitor public image is link-only; price currency/locale/renewal terms need bounded wording or separate clarification.
No measured speed, safety, savings, secure-erasure or matching-accuracy comparisons.
